limits: Only explicitly supplied run.json files and existing proof helpers/reference facts read. Structured calls/results are decoded from the known runtime envelope, never arbitrary message strings. Runtime snapshots may retain or omit prior calls; call IDs do not independently persist an executionRunId. Result receipts with IDs can be joined to exact-run receipt records. No raw text, prompt, source path, provider data or content is emitted. Exact string hashes intentionally do not normalize line endings/BOMs or silently treat mismatches as equivalent.
